# jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro computer enrollment invitation by numeric `id` or by its Jamf Pro-generated `invitation` code (the admin UI "Invitation ID"). Exactly one of `id` or `invitation` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Jamf lists this under **Platform environment** scope (preferred for new integrations) or **Tenant** scope. You choose an integration's scope when you create it in Jamf Account, and cannot change it afterwards. The provider names the scopes it accepts when you configure it, and for a few families that is wider than Jamf lists here. Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enrollment | Enrollment invitations | Read | `enrollment-invitations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a computer invitation by its numeric ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation" "example_by_id" {
  id = "42"
}

# Look up a computer invitation by its Jamf Pro-generated invitation code (the
# admin UI "Invitation ID"). Exactly one of id or invitation must be supplied.
data "jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation" "example_by_invitation" {
  invitation = "308000000000000000000000000000000000001"
}

output "computer_invitation_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation.example_by_id
}

output "computer_invitation_example_by_invitation" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation.example_by_invitation
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric computer invitation ID. Mutually exclusive with `invitation`.
- `invitation` (String) Invitation code generated by Jamf Pro (the admin UI "Invitation ID"). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_account_if_does_not_exist` (Boolean) Whether the SSH management account is created if it does not exist.
- `enroll_into_site_id` (String) Jamf Pro site ID the enrolled computer is assigned to (`-1` when none).
- `enroll_into_site_name` (String) Display name of the site the enrolled computer is assigned to (`NONE` when none).
- `expiration_date` (String) Invitation expiration (`Unlimited` or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`).
- `expiration_date_epoch` (String) Expiration date as epoch milliseconds.
- `expiration_date_utc` (String) Expiration date in UTC.
- `hide_account` (Boolean) Whether the SSH management account is hidden.
- `invitation_status` (String) Current status of the invitation.
- `invitation_type` (String) Invitation delivery type.
- `invited_user_uuid` (String) UUID of the invited user.
- `keep_existing_site_membership` (Boolean) Whether an enrolling computer keeps its existing site membership.
- `lock_down_ssh` (Boolean) Whether SSH is restricted to the management account.
- `multiple_uses_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the invitation may be used for more than one computer.
- `ssh_username` (String) Username of the SSH management account.
- `times_used` (Number) Number of times the invitation has been used.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
